## Activity

During January 2020, Central Eye Clinic completed 152 captures. This activity represents the imaging workload recorded for the month and provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the results returned through the grading process.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.0. These images could not be used for a grading outcome and are reported separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. The ungradable total and rate provide a measure of the proportion of monthly activity affected by image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 23 referable results from the January 2020 activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure records the central turnaround time for images progressing through the grading workflow. Together, the referable result count and the median lag summarise the grading outcome and the timeliness of review for the month.
